primary_question: Can evidence-grounded assistance reduce radio candidate review effort while preserving independently measured injected-signal retention?

scope.receiver: one receiver selected at data feasibility gate; C-band preferred for continuity

proposed_main_group_split.unit: connected components linking shared raw data, sessions, and targets

proposed_primary_decision_criteria.technical_endpoint: paired automated end-to-end injection retention difference against validation-selected non-LLM comparator
proposed_primary_decision_criteria.review_endpoint: relative reduction in mean active native-event review time
proposed_primary_decision_criteria.claim_scope: declared locked benchmark distribution; future-session transportability separately evaluated
proposed_primary_decision_criteria.insufficient_precision_action: report inconclusive and retain ranking/summary-only mode

stop_rules: Do not infer population sensitivity from the single completed fixture.
Do not proceed to an AI claim without complete coverage and stage-loss accounting.
Do not infer test independence from the number of patches or simulator draws.
Stop AI expansion if it fails to improve on the strongest validated conventional workflow.
Do not claim human productivity improvement without the appropriate reviewer study.
Do not claim extraterrestrial origin from a model classification or synthetic recovery.
